limits: File hashing/JSON parsing/test indexing are mechanical coverage, not line-by-line semantic review of every raw trace.
Historical tests and network/funded experiments were not rerun.
Original experiment build revisions and original checksum manifests remain authoritative for their original runs.
Current pinned source may postdate a measurement; it is not proof that this exact binary produced old timing numbers.

adoption_map.title: Checked RLP / legacy TX / signer
adoption_map.rule: Unit 1: reuse the reviewed normalized implementation and actual lock after the existing package acceptance. Preserve byte-exact vectors, short r/s, low-S, wrong-chain/sender checks and empty output on error. Do not clone old per-binary RLP helpers or treat buffer-capacity tests as proof of zero allocations in every dependency. The local reference copy is byte-identical to the reviewed ZIP, not a production import.

adoption_map.title: V6 ABI, CREATE2 and precise old defect
adoption_map.rule: Unit 2: exact 20-byte deployer, 32-byte salt, witnessed EIP-1167 init code/implementation; source profile must bind all inputs. Port wrong 32-byte deployer padding, wrong implementation, malformed/oversize ABI and unknown-mode rejection. Fixed historical addresses are fixture/profile facts, never a substitute for current deployment qualification.

adoption_map.title: Independent historical and immediate BUY execution
adoption_map.rule: Units 2/3: preserve Router→Portal historical first BUY separately from later direct BUY and immediate post-launch direct BUY. Missing executable code is UNWITNESSED, not zero code or a trading-disabled verdict. Port exact minOutput success/+1 revert and pre-launch revert. These offline scripts are oracle fixtures, not runtime dependencies; old relative paths require explicit relocation if rerun.

adoption_map.title: State dependencies, invalidators and oracle admission
adoption_map.rule: Units 2/3 + C2: convert every relevant row into a named resident/derived input, invalidator, refresh owner and admission guard. Port deadline equality success, deadline+1 rejection, revoked signer role and missing role storage. Do not scan all rows per signal, substitute observed outputs, or fabricate future time/private state.

adoption_map.title: Exact DOGE and native-BNB arithmetic
adoption_map.rule: Unit 3/G: preserve operation order, combined-fee rounding and exact outputs. Historical code uses assertions and unchecked U256 additions outside its fixture bounds: validate widths/ranges and use checked/widened operations with typed rejection for production inputs. Cover r+reserve, total+h, reserve+net, products, division and subtraction. No panic/wraparound from an admissible external input; no zero minimum. New amount/caller/tick/tax branches require their own proof.

adoption_map.title: Economic dedup, nonce order and final envelope binding
adoption_map.test: [lane regression suite](https://github.com/sawyerma/darkbot/blob/eaba1afe5ad5834a92ea0a9fb915792e2473cb15/bsc/gates/gate0/src/intent_lane.rs#L179); [256 final-envelope bindings and counterexamples](https://github.com/sawyerma/darkbot/blob/eaba1afe5ad5834a92ea0a9fb915792e2473cb15/bsc/gates/gate0/src/bin/g06_concurrency.rs#L515); [8,000 signals / 1,000 intents result](https://github.com/sawyerma/darkbot/blob/eaba1afe5ad5834a92ea0a9fb915792e2473cb15/bsc/gates/gate0/evidence/g06_intent_lane/result.json); [injected HoL evidence](https://github.com/sawyerma/darkbot/blob/eaba1afe5ad5834a92ea0a9fb915792e2473cb15/bsc/gates/gate0/evidence/g06_submission_hol_recovery/result.json)
adoption_map.rule: Unit 4: port transition invariants, whole-session dedup and cross-chain/sender rejection into bounded preallocated storage. Do not copy BTreeMap insertion, test Mutex/workers or eight-sender layout into the hotpath. Hash uniqueness is not economic dedup; atomic nonce assignment is not dispatch ordering. Waiting for unresolved head must remain visible in admission/latency/coverage results.

adoption_map.title: Full/hash ingress, coverage and first-actionable race
adoption_map.rule: C1/F: retain hash/full/actionable separation, chain/readiness/peer evidence and first verified actionable wins across enabled sources. The Reth sensor filters a known self-launch hash; it is not generic foreign-launch qualification. Its ignored try_send failures and dropped peer metadata are diagnostic limitations; production must record overflow and provenance. Do not use its polling intervals/channel topology as the production Fast Lane.

adoption_map.title: Permit-before-write and durable restart quarantine
adoption_map.rule: Units 4/5 + C2: permit before first possible write; ACK never confirms; partial/flush error remains UNKNOWN/HALT. Stable durable fence before admission, no filesystem on BUY path. Adapt single-sink begin_send into one economic admission plus once-only per-adapter permits; do not call begin_send twice or mint a new nonce for builder B. Canonical resume is new C2 work.

adoption_map.title: Local component and integrated performance evidence
adoption_map.rule: C3: retain these as demonstrated local feasibility and component baselines. Do not restart architecture selection or rerun old probes without a concrete need. Benchmark the actual new integrated runtime because these local sink returns are neither geth propagation nor a real BUY. Do not add component percentiles to manufacture an integrated percentile.

adoption_map.title: Remote transport and all tail failures
adoption_map.rule: Unit 5/C3: retain payload/framing/write/ACK boundaries and all errors. These probes deliberately corrupt transaction bytes and some summaries are user-supplied terminal records. Do not treat method recognition or invalid-transaction rejection as valid bundle acceptance; do not copy per-sample fresh lanes, sleeps, response waits or wire corruption into production.

adoption_map.title: Prepared transport versus on-signal target diagnostic
adoption_map.rule: Unit 5/C3: preserve the measured preparation advantage and exact numbers. The prepared harness uses padded read-only eth_chainId, not a signed bundle. Its select-only t_ready becomes T_select in production; original T_ready is retained. Current-target 0.274125 ms is ready-p50. Strict misses count >=1,000,000 ns; old > counters are historical fields. Qualify actual production bytes/boundaries separately.

adoption_map.title: Ordered bundle bytes, separate wallets, budget and authorization
adoption_map.code: [ordered identical TX projection](https://github.com/sawyerma/darkbot/blob/eaba1afe5ad5834a92ea0a9fb915792e2473cb15/bsc/gates/gate0/src/bin/g06a_self_launch_bundle.rs#L492); [final signer recovery and DRY binding](https://github.com/sawyerma/darkbot/blob/eaba1afe5ad5834a92ea0a9fb915792e2473cb15/bsc/gates/gate0/src/bin/g06a_self_launch_bundle.rs#L457); [historical authorization guard](https://github.com/sawyerma/darkbot/blob/eaba1afe5ad5834a92ea0a9fb915792e2473cb15/bsc/gates/gate0/src/acceptance_guard.rs#L100); [floor probe diagnostic](https://github.com/sawyerma/darkbot/blob/eaba1afe5ad5834a92ea0a9fb915792e2473cb15/bsc/gates/gate0/src/bin/g06a_48club_floor_probe.rs#L62)
adoption_map.rule: Units 5/6: preserve [original launch, exact BUY], same BUY bytes/nonce across builders and verified provider-specific field encodings. Separate launcher/buyer belongs to controlled self-launch qualification, not a production multi-buyer redesign. Same-wallet diagnostic cannot pass its two-wallet contract. Historical ceilings, 1-gwei policy and environment-fed expected output are not production defaults/oracles. No network capability or existing authorization follows from this DRY source.

adoption_map.title: Real acquisitions and prepared known-hash restriction
adoption_map.code: [prepare/sign before launch](https://github.com/sawyerma/darkbot/blob/eaba1afe5ad5834a92ea0a9fb915792e2473cb15/bsc/gates/gate0/src/bin/g07_testnet_birth_buy.rs#L775); [known-hash trigger and measured send](https://github.com/sawyerma/darkbot/blob/eaba1afe5ad5834a92ea0a9fb915792e2473cb15/bsc/gates/gate0/src/bin/g07_testnet_birth_buy.rs#L875); [postsend evidence verification](https://github.com/sawyerma/darkbot/blob/eaba1afe5ad5834a92ea0a9fb915792e2473cb15/bsc/gates/gate0/src/bin/g07_testnet_birth_buy.rs#L896); [earlier direct testnet acquisition](https://github.com/sawyerma/darkbot/blob/eaba1afe5ad5834a92ea0a9fb915792e2473cb15/bsc/gates/gate0/src/bin/g07_testnet_buy.rs#L159)
adoption_map.rule: C3/J: preserve actual acquisition and placement independently of local timing. Pre-sign only an exactly known valid candidate; do not apply self-launch hash shortcuts to unknown launches. Production binding/admission precedes egress even though historical diagnostics verify additional facts afterwards. Fixed TESTNET_MIN_OUTPUT, pre-send RPC setup and top-level-only competitor scans are not production policies. No receipt-observation duration becomes T_buy.

adoption_map.title: Complete receipt/event attribution and raw 15-second capture
adoption_map.test: [raw BUY receipt](https://github.com/sawyerma/darkbot/blob/eaba1afe5ad5834a92ea0a9fb915792e2473cb15/bsc/gates/gate0/evidence/g07_hash_trigger_testnet_20261003T002258Z/buy_receipt.json); [all Portal BUY events in both blocks](https://github.com/sawyerma/darkbot/blob/eaba1afe5ad5834a92ea0a9fb915792e2473cb15/bsc/gates/gate0/evidence/g07_hash_trigger_testnet_20261003T002258Z/portal_buy_logs_launch_through_buy.json)
adoption_map.rule: C0 recorder/F/J: capture all receipt-internal events, receipt/block TX-set equality and creator-vs-external identity, plus original producer brackets. The two-block receipt proof is not an implemented 15-second recorder. Original producer timing was absent; subsequent storage or replay cannot retroactively create it. Implement §§9/11 without changing the strict <1-ms acceptance.

adoption_map.title: Pinned geth/SPSC and exact-core integration
adoption_map.rule: C0/C1/C3/I: geth owns chain-client duties; one Rust core owns semantics. No existing Gate-0 snippet implements the production mmap/SPSC or original producer hooks. Those are explicit new work, with schema/lifetime/clock/overflow tests before consumers freeze; never mark them inherited PASS. No extra task/serialization hop per module.

adoption_map.title: Retired Python counterexamples and single C2 owner
adoption_map.rule: C2: port first-seen, sender/nonce candidates, late-pending, receipt identity, reorg/backfill/high-water and restart counterexamples as native tests. Do not import the old Python runtime/migrations, add a second state owner in the nonce module or let an old scheduling clause override §1.

adoption_map.title: 30-minute native capture plus per-attempt windows
adoption_map.rule: F: preserve clean continuous 30-minute binary capture, canonical denominator and exact-core replay in addition to each 15-second launch window. No Python normalization before primary capture, no first-seen overwrite, no silent overflow. Observer lead is diagnostic and cannot be called original T0.

adoption_map.title: Full economics and exit-cost acceptance
adoption_map.rule: G/H: retain buy/sell/approval/permit/revert/replacement/migration scope and receipt-based realized costs. Bind replay to exact economic snapshot, not a guessed percentage or zero cost. No strategy tuning/EV claim until economics passes. Earlier loose >3-ms prose does not override this master's strict deadline.

adoption_map.title: Flap full decoder and distinct Four families
adoption_map.rule: D/E: support only witnessed selectors/code/modes and test duplicate/revert/orphan/malformed/oversize/binary-roundtrip cases. Four Classic and OpenFour stay separate; post-execution TokenCreate never proves a pre-execution address. No hypothetical new protocol or automatic inheritance of Flap proof.

adoption_map.title: Phase-A isolation and preserved Solana baseline
adoption_map.rule: C0/H/I: preserve existing Solana behavior and the non-runnable Python BSC profile boundary. Phase-A synthetic/Solana measurements are not native BSC acquisition evidence. Use relevant parity regressions when touching shared entry points; no wholesale historical runtime migration or generic multichain rewrite.
